name: Alessandro Rossi
bio:
Alessandro's journey into motorsport started with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, fueled by watching races with his father in their small town near Monza. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in simulation and modeling. After graduating, Alessandro joined a small engineering firm, where he honed his skills in creating realistic driving simulations. His passion for precision and detail quickly made him a valuable asset. 

He joined Boutsen VDS five years ago, drawn by their ambitious goals and commitment to innovation. Alessandro excels at fine-tuning the simulator, ensuring it accurately reflects the car's performance and provides drivers with crucial feedback. His pragmatic approach allows him to quickly identify and resolve issues, making him a highly reliable member of the team. He is known for his meticulous nature and relentless pursuit of realism in the simulator environment, always striving to enhance the driver's experience and improve lap times.

 Alessandro is also known for his resourcefulness in adapting the simulator to model real-world track conditions like ambient temperature and humidity, giving drivers a deeper understanding of how these factors affect performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alessandro is of average height with a lean build, and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when concentrating.
Insists on calibrating the simulator's force feedback system before every session, even if it was done the day before.
